- Type: Time (Minutes)

- Description: Usage-logging tooling for truesight_autopilot_transcript (append_usage / write_meta / summarize_usage + tests)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/865
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot_transcript/commit/bcb39c0

  Delivered (all live on truesight_autopilot_transcript@main):
  - scripts/append_usage.py — appends one LLM usage row per tool call to sessions/<date>/<sid>/usage.jsonl (validates required fields, auto-sets ts/schema_version)
  - scripts/write_meta.py — idempotent upsert of session meta.json (SCHEMA.md §1)
  - scripts/summarize_usage.py — cost CLI: --session / --date / --since / --by provider_model|provider|caller
  - scripts/tests/test_usage_tools.py — 5 pytest tests (fixed a real validator bug: ts in REQUIRED blocked auto-set)
  
  Local suite green (compileall + ruff + format + 5/5 pytest). Smoke-verified append→summarize end-to-end. Backlog closed out: OPEN_FOLLOWUPS #857 entry moved to Recently shipped via agentic_ai_context #865.
  
  Remaining follow-up (flagged in shipped entry): wiring the autopilot runtime harness's transcript-append path to call append_usage.py (harness is not in a DAO repo).
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
